parsed.title: Inconsistent Next: instruction for replan-class
parsed.detail: The table row for `freeze-batch (≥ 1 replan-class row)` claims the consumer should run `node scripts/unit-route.mjs <unit> → the planner it names re-cuts the plan, then /review-plan before /execute-phase on this unit`. However, the `replan-in-unit` logic in `skills/review-implementation/references/CLASSIFY.md` and `skills/plan-fix/references/PLANNING_PROCESS.md` specifies that the planner re-cuts the SPEC, but the `fold-findings` skill's own `Done when` section and `replan-in-unit` description in `skills/triage-issue/SKILL.md` do not explicitly mandate the `/review-plan` step as part of the consumer's immediate next command sequence, creating ambiguity in the hand-off contract.
